rows.text: The initial main-case gap has been resolved by the actual orbit and Hopf comparison P3F.7--13, the real trace P3K.6--7, the independent analytic index calculation P3K.8, and the rotating-frame computation P3K.9. These prove zero positive-loop class for the original family and give \((k,\ell)=(-1,-4)\) in the stated descended framing. P3F.25 applies the same actual trace to the further verified families and computes the nonzero weighted OS47 example. The actual component-supported OS49 page and both diagonal-fan returns are proved in P3F.31--32 and P3K.17, retaining the marking of P3F.27. The exact earlier status passages are preserved, with their superseding proof identifiers, in \path{records/part3_superseded_status.md}.

For the component-supported OS49 target in the prompt with \(Q=3P\), the regular-binding degree-three page has three \(II\) and three \(I_2\) fibres, hence \(\chi(\mathcal O)=1\), \(\sigma=-8\), \(h(P)=1/2\), and total reducible-fibre correction \(3/2\). The height formula gives \(P\cdot O=0\). Its component-permuting translation is carried through the actual positive-fan page in P3F.31--32 and through the charged Cox comparison to the negative fan in P3K.17. Both sphere sectors have return index zero by those explicit morphisms.

The positive OS49 loop over $\lambda=r^3$ has actual cusp angular cycle $K=3u+2\gamma$ and retained line clutch of winding six on the sixth-root cusp cover. The exact change of page marking is given below; its original direct graph-line comparison is retained as an auxiliary route, while P3K.17 proves the actual return index zero.

This direct graph-line comparison was the unresolved route at the first writing of P3F.27. P3F.31 subsequently constructed the actual positive-fan page through its line-complement subfan. P3K.17 then constructed the actual charged Cox flop bordism and proved that both diagonal fillings have return index zero. The direct negative-fan graph homotopy is not needed by that completed proof.

The old degree-three compact elliptic pullback has three \(II\) and three \(I_2\) fibres, \(\chi=1\), signature \(-8\), height \(1/2\), total component correction \(3/2\), and \(G\cdot O=0\). These numbers are checked. Their actual positive-fan page identification is P3F.31, and the negative-fan return is related to it by the explicit bordism of P3K.17. The earlier direct graph homotopy remains an uncompleted auxiliary route. The boundary marking and the obstruction to that particular homotopy recorded above are retained exactly.

The actual OS49 linearization gives the exact sequence $0\to T^*M\to M\to\mathcal O_{C_0}(-1)\to0$. Its iterates alternate the two components, and all the translated source-line direct images vanish. The direct mixed-circle symbol comparison is an auxiliary route; P3K.17 computes the actual return independently.

\] Consequently every \(n=1\) or \(n=-1\) member is the standard smooth six-sphere, for every \(k\) and every delta twist \(d\). This statement determines topology in its coprime sector. P3F.31--32 construct and compute the actual positive-fan page and return; P3K.17 proves equality with the negative-fan return, so both sphere sectors have index zero. P3F.34 supplies the additional torsion factor in the more general noncoprime free-cap sector.

The actual quadratic norm morphism has target line $N=M\otimes T^*M=M^2(-C_0)$ and scalar $\lambda^2$. It completes to $X/\mu_2$, with transverse $A_1$ equation along the fixed curve. The two fixed sections of its resolution have opposite Hopf-line base shifts $+1,-1$, which must be retained in this auxiliary norm route. The actual return is zero by P3K.17.

Conjugating the negative-weight line makes the circle representation positive on both summands. The first resulting bundle is \(\mathcal O(2)\oplus\mathcal O\), and the second is \(\mathcal O\oplus\mathcal O(-2)\). Factoring out respectively \(\mathcal O(1)\) and \(\mathcal O(-1)\) leaves \(\mathcal O(1)\oplus\mathcal O(-1)\), a topologically trivial \(SU(2)\) bundle on the sphere. The factored line is precisely the additional base factor in the associated Hopf line. Its degrees are \(+1\) and \(-1\). In particular an index comparison through this actual norm quotient must retain both opposite base factors. This norm-quotient route does not yet identify its total correction with the mixed-circle trace of P3F.27. The actual zero return for both diagonal fillings is proved separately by P3F.31--32 and P3K.17.

The explicit positive-diagonal OS49 filling over $\lambda=r^3$ is a sphere family with positive-loop return index zero, oriented homotopy-sphere class zero, and product mapping torus. Its actual page carries the source line through both $I_2$ components and nodes. P3K.17 gives the actual charged flop comparison with the negative-diagonal filling.

This calculation constructs the explicit positive-diagonal family. P3K.17 subsequently proves that the negative-diagonal family in P3F.26 has the same actual return, by its charged Cox bordism including the extra fixed-locus sphere-bundle boundary. The supplied E26 Mumford proposition permits arbitrary periodic unimodular triangulations and does not select one of these diagonals. Its literal Remark8.5 requires a whole-fibre divisor, so bare OS49 with component divisor \(C_0\) is the additional configuration separately requested by the prompt, rather than an instance of that particular hypothesis.
